user.title: Set up Battery Care?
user.description: Battery Care will automatically discover the battery-powered devices connected to Home Assistant. Critical batteries are notified at once; everything else comes in one daily summary. You can change all of this later in the Battery Care panel.

data_description.phones: Phones and tablets with the Home Assistant app. Notifications always appear in Home Assistant.
data_description.digest_time: Low batteries, devices that stopped responding and batteries back to normal are listed once a day.
data_description.quiet_hours: No notification during these hours, not even for a critical battery: it is sent when they end.

error.quiet_hours_empty: Quiet hours must end at another time than they start.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Battery Care is already set up.

storage_too_new.message: Battery Care data was saved by a newer version of Battery Care. Update Battery Care, or restore a backup made with this version.
